instruction: Use this to orient yourself in the quantum-mechanics material.
primary_question: Which interface would I voluntarily continue using to understand quantum mechanics?

cognitive_load: Do I feel invited to explore or compelled to read?

Does anything compete unnecessarily for attention?
immediate_orientation: Does my brain know where to look first?

navigation: When I focus on a concept, do I retain orientation?

trust: Can I distinguish real semantic relationships from presentation grouping?
